title: Jointure
summary: JOINT'URE, noun An estate in lands or tenements, settled on a woman in consideration of marriage, and which she is to enjoy after her husband's decease. JOINT'URE, verb transitive To settle a jointure

inlines.v: JOINT'URE, noun An estate in lands or tenements, settled on a woman in consideration of marriage, and which she is to enjoy after her husband's decease. JOINT'URE, verb transitive To settle a jointure upon.
